# attribution text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attributionText>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The credit line to display when reusing the asset ([schema:creditText](https://schema.org/creditText); [cc:attributionName](http://creativecommons.org/ns#attributionName)) — e.g. "Photo by Jane Doe / CC BY 4.0". The structured holder is [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) / [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the ready-to-display credit line for reusing an asset ([schema:creditText](https://schema.org/creditText), [cc:attributionName](http://creativecommons.org/ns#attributionName)) — the human-readable string an attribution duty asks reusers to show.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the structured rights holder (that is [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) / [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md)) and avoid putting the link target here, which is [`gmeow:attributionUrl`](gmeow-attributionUrl.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md) on the asset to the formatted credit line; pair it with [`gmeow:attributionUrl`](gmeow-attributionUrl.md) for the link, and keep the structured holder on [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md).

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md) "Photo by Jane Doe / CC BY 4.0".
